text: Hello, I'm here with you. Let's take one small step together. A little focus, a little rest. You're doing well.
description: An original tiny animated rabbit courier companion voice. Light high feminine cartoon soprano, feathery sweet rounded resonance, a bright little smile and buoyant soft hop-like phrasing. Cute, eager and gently playful, with nimble clear syllables and reassuring warmth. Avoid ordinary adult alto, authoritative mission delivery, breathy whispering, shrill shouting or singing.
